opportunities.title: Consultant Pharmacist in Antimicrobial Stewardship
opportunities.why_you: Your reputation for antimicrobial stewardship, plus your habit of persuading doctors without authority over them (cross-professional influencing), is what a consultant post leans on. Your teaching of juniors fits the education strand.

opportunities.title: Pharmacist with a portfolio career: clinical, teaching and project work
opportunities.why_you: Variety is one of your three drivers. Your confirmed teaching and mentoring and your practised way of onboarding newcomers every four months could become a paid strand beside your ward work.
opportunities.source_title: How a portfolio career like mine could give the pharmacy workforce a boost

opportunities.title: Credentialed advanced pharmacist practitioner
opportunities.why_you: Your quick risk judgement in acute medicine and your years in Care of the Elderly are the kind of evidence an advanced practice portfolio asks for. The Pharmaceutical Journal reports that pharmacists are now being credentialed through an e-portfolio system.
opportunities.source_title: First pharmacists credentialed as advanced practitioners under new e-portfolio system

opportunities.title: Part-week deprescribing pharmacist for care homes
opportunities.why_you: Your five years in Care of the Elderly give you a feel for polypharmacy and frailty, and your influencing of senior colleagues carries over to GPs and care home teams. Research on pharmacist independent prescribers in UK care homes looks at the role and what affects how much deprescribing they do.
opportunities.source_title: Pharmacist-independent prescriber deprescribing in UK care homes: Contextual factors associated with increased activity

opportunities.title: Pharmacy clinical informatics and decision support
opportunities.why_you: You see where prescribing goes wrong at the bedside, and that is what a safer electronic system needs from a clinician. Your influencing skills help when you have to persuade doctors to accept an alert or a new workflow.
opportunities.source_title: Pharmacy Informatics and Its Cross-Functional Role in Healthcare

opportunities.title: Clinical pharmacist working alongside AI medicines safety tools
opportunities.why_you: You want to hand over reconciliation and incident review but keep the escalation decisions. This role is about doing exactly that, with your rapid risk judgement as the check on what the tools produce. A published review looks at how AI is changing clinical and hospital pharmacy.
opportunities.source_title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on the Future of Clinical Pharmacy and Hospital Pharmacy
